messages.content:
Risk: Upstream Transparency Issues
Description: The AI system's upstream providers or components in the value chain may lack transparency, potentially increasing uncertainty and risk, and making it challenging to assess the system's compliance, performance, or security.
Concern: None
Policy: Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risks

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/Underlier: underlier — something that can be assigned a value in the marketplace that forms the basis for a derivative or pool-backed instrument [found by 3/3 queries]
  Siblings: asset, controlled thing, collateral
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/MarketIndices/BasketIndices/BasketOfCreditRisks: basket of credit risks — basket of instruments, legal entities, or a combination thereof collected for the purpose of analyzing risk [found by 2/3 queries]
  Siblings: basket of credit default swaps, basket of securities, exchange rate structure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments.
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/DER/DerivativesContracts/DerivativesBasics/UniqueProductIdentifierServiceProvider: unique product identifier service provider — organization designated by an external body of financial regulators to assign UPIs and operate a UPI reference data library
  Siblings: national numbering agency, business registration authority
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/ThirdPartyAgent: third-party agent — any service provider that is licensed to perform a legally binding function and has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party
  Siblings: licensed agent, registered agent, bond registrar
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/MarketIndices/BasketIndices/CreditIndexConstituent: credit index constituent — constituent of a basket of credit risks [from restriction: hasMember on BasketOfCreditRisks]
  Siblings: ledger entry, cash flow, individual transaction

axes.rationale: The third-party agent represents the upstream providers or components in the value chain that may lack transparency, directly relating to the risk described.
The basket of credit risks can be seen as the collective set of instruments or entities that contribute to the overall risk and uncertainty in the AI system's value chain.
